decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several portable Bluetooth speakers across different price points and form factors. My consideration set included the JBL Clip 3, a renewed JBL Flip 5, the feature-rich ZEALOT bike speaker, the rugged HyperGear Beast XL, and the budget-friendly Comiso. I ultimately chose the JBL Clip 3 because of its overwhelming number of positive reviews (over 68,000) and high 4.7 rating, which signals long-term reliability and durability for a portable outdoor speaker compared to the budget alternatives which had mixed longevity feedback in the reviews.
